# ShortUUID v4.0.0 - Table of Contents

Encode UUIDs into Base58, with optional Ecto integration for prefixed IDs.

## Pages

- [ShortUUID](https://short-uuid.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://short-uuid.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [LICENSE](https://short-uuid.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [ShortUUID](https://short-uuid.hexdocs.pm/ShortUUID.md): 
- [ShortUUID.Guards](https://short-uuid.hexdocs.pm/ShortUUID.Guards.md)
- [ShortUUID.Prefixed](https://short-uuid.hexdocs.pm/ShortUUID.Prefixed.md): An Ecto parameterized type that generates prefixed ShortUUIDs.
- [ShortUUID.Prefixed.Schema](https://short-uuid.hexdocs.pm/ShortUUID.Prefixed.Schema.md): A convenience macro for setting up Ecto schemas with prefixed ShortUUID primary keys.
